_doc: depcheck has a high false-positive rate (runtime-loaded packages,
subpath imports, transitive types). The .depcheckrc.json at the
repo root captures the curated ignore set. This baseline locks in
the post-cleanup numbers; new genuinely-unused additions raise
the count and fail the guard.
PR 4.3 floor (after dropping 8 confirmed-unused prod deps): 48 / 10 / 1.
2026-06 local CI pass: observed unused prod deps=50 after cloning
and installing the current workspace; no new dependency was added
by the product/Immigration work, so this records the local floor
see frontend/src runtime imports (the same reason @sentry/react,
@mui/material and react-router-dom already sit inside this floor),
so it is a confirmed false positive, not genuinely-unused debt.
Rule: any PR that increases these numbers fails the guard.
